notes.title: Control:Override is 69% off to celebrate the launch of the Compress(space) demo!
notes.content:
Our next game, Compress(space) now has a steam demo!

Compress(space) has a similar design philosophy with a focus on puzzles that make you feel like you're breaking the game, this time with a world breaking mechanic twist.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38657351/1fde0e2cdd0e8e797fd564916bc3a1cb970432b0.gif[/img]

If you liked Control:Override's puzzles. You'll love Compress(space).

You can check out the demo here:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3768930/Compressspace_Demo/

notes.title: Compress(space), our next game, just launched its steam page.
notes.content:
Our next game, Compress(space) now has a steam page!

Compress(space) has a similar design philosophy with a focus on puzzles that make you feel like you're breaking the game, this time with a world breaking mechanic twist.

The game is built around the space folding mechanic. You can fold any part of the level at any time.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38657351/1fde0e2cdd0e8e797fd564916bc3a1cb970432b0.gif[/img]
As you might expect, it quickly gets complicated.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38657351/43eb2e520839545c0cd6c1ce851935fe3fbbb29e.gif[/img]

If you're a fan of Control:Override, you'll love Compress(space). We'd love it if you check the game out and wishlist it.
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3664840/Compressspace/

notes.title: Smoother gamepad controls + UX improvements + Bug fixes
notes.content:
[h1]Patch notes:[/h1]
[olist]
[*] Smoother gamepad aiming
[*] Slow-mo during aiming to make it easier
[*] Some issues with gamepad controls not showing on tutorials fixed.
[*] Default gamepad bindings reworked.

notes.title: Control:Override is now available in Japanese!
notes.content:
Hello everyone, we’re happy to announce that Control:Override has been translated and is now fully playable in Japanese! 
The game will automatically detect the system language and change to Japanese when you first start the game.
If needed, to change the language, start the game -> Options-> Language. 
A huge thank you to all the fans that made this possible!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1406090/ControlOverride/

notes.title: Control:Override ver 1.06: 32-bit version added and some UX improvements
notes.content:
Full patch notes:
1. Can now transfer powers attached from one platform to another without needing to remove it first.
2. 32-bit version added.
3. Some crash fixes.
4. Demo is now fully playable in Japanese.
5. Better selection of demo levels.

The game should automatically download the 32-bit version if your device needs it. If you face any issues, please post in the steam forums.

notes.title: The playtest period is now over. Thank you to everyone for participating!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38657351/b6a5ad9e8bc02d82d890bfb7035fcc059aece544.gif[/img]

The Steam Playtest period for Control : Override is over. A huge shoutout to everyone who participated!

The response was much higher than we anticipated. Thanks to you, we've been able to identify several issues and streamline the experience for new players. Going forward, our main focus will be on finishing the game. Expect release date related news soon.

Note that the demo is still and will always be available.

Additionally, if you didn't have a chance to fill up the in-game feedback form, [url=https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSeUdHAePeNbSnSIuP88sb3Zli53SYRKIV1qC9E76nlMnyAb-A/viewform?usp=sf_link]you can fill it up here[/url].

The form will be open for another week. Reminder that you can have your name in the credits by submitting it in the form!

Once again, thank you to you all and We hope to see you again on release!

notes.title: Control:Override Public Playtest is Live! Here's what's different from the Demo.
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38657351/0217c7befe9339733b5a065e91005e6b8375d451.gif[/img]

Go to the steam page and hit the request access button to join! Note that requests  are approved in batches due to how the steam playtest feature works.

The playtest will be active up to release. Note that it it has a different selection of levels from the demo and is NOT balanced to be your first experience with the game.

The main purpose of the playtest is to offer players interested in the game a chance to give further feedback. This will help with balancing the newer levels. Playtesters will also get credited in the final game if they fill in the feedback form.

If you mainly want to get a quick idea of the game, the demo is ideal and unlike the playtest, it is available instantly and forever.

Lastly, if you get stuck in any level, I encourage you to post in the steam Forums as the difficulty needs some tuning.

notes.title: The final demo is up and will be available indefinitely.
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38657351/84fc8e7e24d8bc2e97ec6364d621c9d92da16825.gif[/img]
As planned, the final demo is now available. This version of the demo will reflect the final version of the game and has a new selection of levels to showcase the new, streamlined mechanics of the game.

It will also be available up to and beyond release of the final game. Feel free to try out the demo for free and wishlist the game if you like it.

The playtest period will begin at some later point.

notes.title: New Demo Coming up! And Playtest period too!
notes.content:
Hello,
It's been pretty quiet over here, hasn't it? Development has reached the final phase. a new demo will be available on 11Th February 10 AM PST. 

It'll have a new selection of levels. For those who've played the first demo, about 50% of the levels are new. It also has some gameplay changes to make puzzle solving a lot smoother.

This time, it will be available permanently.

And also expect a pubic beta test soon.

That's all. See you when the game releases.

notes.title: Control : Override - Steam Game Festival Quick Pitch
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38657351/0e97af3bd9451412b22dddef67fe2e9c0cc1d088.gif[/img]
B-DeshiDev here. I'm a solo developer making Control : Override. 

It's a neon soaked puzzle game set inside an AI that YOU created. Control is not a given. Regain control. Solve puzzles. Break through the AI's security layers to terminate it.

And perhaps see a brief glimpse into the truth in this demo.
